governance.principle: Independent repositories integrate through pinned manifests, explicit adapters and testable evidence; the kernel remains a small privileged core.
governance.dependency_rule: No cyclic source dependencies. Each repository owns its implementation and release.
governance.admission_rule: A capability manifest is descriptive metadata, not executable permission or a security sandbox.
governance.release_rule: Cross-repository compatibility is reported separately from each repository's local test status.

repositories.name: NUNLauncher
repositories.security_boundary: ordinary Android application; no bootloader or firmware write privileges

repositories.name: SAMBU
repositories.security_boundary: Python interpreter and experimental native IR are user-space/developer components

repositories.name: ToolNG
repositories.security_boundary: Windows-only device enumeration and UI remain outside the kernel

repositories.name: ReaperCripple
repositories.security_boundary: exact SoC/board profile and target tests are required for hardware claims

repositories.name: Kloz
repositories.security_boundary: accounting is not page protection, allocation interception or a sandbox

repositories.name: CO
repositories.security_boundary: caller serializes access; one callback is executed per poll

repositories.name: SaintSI
repositories.security_boundary: health is observation; CRC-32 is accidental-corruption detection only

repositories.name: Klipot
repositories.security_boundary: portal presentation cannot grant system permissions or activate unverified code

duck_ui.principle: black graphite surfaces, semantic yellow accents, visible focus and text-plus-icon statuses
